description: One piece of proof filed against a task completion or a compliance record: a photograph, a signature capture, a laboratory report. The row exists so the proof has a caption and a time beside it — a folder of untitled photographs is not evidence, it is a folder.

fields.description: What this is. The type is what lets a completion be checked against its evidence contract without opening anything: a task requiring a signature is not satisfied by four more photographs of the same cabin.
fields.label: Type
fields.options:
Photo
Signature
Document
Lab Report
Video
Other

fields.description: The File record. Files arrive through stage_file_chunk and commit_staged_file, so a photograph taken on a phone in a cabin with no signal gets there in pieces and survives a worker restart on the way.
fields.label: File

fields.description: Where the bytes are, copied off the File when the row is written. Kept because a packet generator that had to resolve every File to render a URL would be a query per photograph, and because it is what stays readable if the File is ever moved.
fields.label: File URL

fields.description: When the evidence was captured, which is not always when it was uploaded — a camp with no signal uploads in the evening.
fields.label: Captured

fields.description: Whether this frame was taken BEFORE the work started or AFTER it finished. Blank is the ordinary case and stays legal forever — most completions have no before frame and never will, and a required phase would refuse the completion a worker cannot go back and re-photograph. v0.96.0. THE PAIR IS THE EVIDENCE, NOT EITHER HALF: a photograph of a repaired valve proves a valve is fine, and the leak beside it proves somebody fixed a leak. Every dispute this app is asked to settle — piece rate, a cabin's condition at check-in, whether a block was sprayed — turns on the state of the thing before the crew arrived, and that frame stops being available the moment the work starts. LOWER CASE, DELIBERATELY: the handset ships `EvidencePhase` as a Swift String enum whose raw values are `before` and `after`, so these are the two strings that round-trip without a translation table on either end. Until this column existed the phase travelled in the filename (`FT-…_photo_before_….jpg`), which an auditor can read and nothing can query.
fields.label: Phase

fields.description: Where this photograph was taken — the handset's fix at the moment of capture (v0.198.0). Blank from an older phone.
fields.label: GPS Latitude

fields.description: What it shows. 'North wall, water stain under the window' is evidence; 'IMG_4471' is a filename.
fields.label: Caption
